correctness.rationale: Set K0=Q(sqrt5), r^2=phi=(1+sqrt5)/2, L=K0(r,i). Phi has norm -1 over Q so is nonsquare in K0; [Q(r):Q]=4, [L:Q]=8. Reconstructed the four source monomial matrices modulo projective scalars, their 16-element A/mu2 orbit and the 16 distinct conic planes; exact integer quotient-ring/Pluecker Galois comparison fixes exactly eight planes under i->-i, transposes four pairs, while both r->-r and combined maps send each plane outside that collection. Thus setwise stabilizer <complex conjugation> gives Q(r) and individual stabilizers give eight Q(r) and eight Q(r,i) conics. Independently reconstructed 16 planes from monomial action with exact K0(r,i)-equivalence; output 16/16/8/0/0. The curve equations and source-quadric restrictions are separately addressed in the inspected exact source verifier; not merely assumed from old PASS.
